title: imify login result
description: Written to stdout by `imify login --json`: the host, the user the login belongs to, and where the login is stored.

host.description: The API URL the login belongs to: scheme, host, port unless it is the default, path without a trailing slash.

subject.description: Stable user id: the `sub` claim of the ID token.

storage.description: Where the login is stored: the OS keychain, or a file readable only by the user.
